prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「职业」？
explanation: career 的意思是职业。

prompt: 「applicant」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: applicant 的意思是申请人。

prompt: 选择表示「面试」的单词。
explanation: 表示面试的单词是 interview。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「资格」？
explanation: qualification 的意思是资格。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「简历」？
explanation: résumé 的意思是简历。

prompt: 「reference」的中文意思是哪一个？
explanation: reference 的意思是推荐信。

prompt: 选择表示「截止日期」的单词。
explanation: 表示截止日期的单词是 deadline。

prompt: 哪个单词的意思是「雇用」？
explanation: employ 的意思是雇用。

prompt: She ___ three interviews since Monday, and the next one is on Friday. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: since Monday 到现在，用现在完成时 has had。

prompt: By the time the deadline arrived, she ___ the résumé. 截止日期到来之前已经寄出，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: arrived 是过去，寄出比它更早，用 had sent。

prompt: 哪一句的时态和时间状语一致？

choices.text: I have worked here in June 2019
I have worked here since June
I had worked here since June now

explanation: since June 持续到现在，用现在完成时。in June 2019 是过去的一点，不用 have worked。

prompt: 面试在下周五。哪一句正确？

choices.text: The interview took place next Friday
The interview has taken place next Friday
The interview will take place next Friday
The interview takes place next Friday as a finished past event

explanation: next Friday 是将来，用 will take place。
verify: "The interview will take place next Friday"

prompt: 只要你在截止日期前交简历，他们就会看。哪一句正确？

choices.text: They will read it provided that you send it before the deadline
They will read it provided that you sent it before the deadline next week
Provided that you will send it, they read it yesterday
They read it provided what you send

explanation: provided that 引导条件，主句是将来，从句用现在时 send。
verify: "They will read it provided that you send it before the deadline"

prompt: You can get the job ___ you pass the interview. 表示只要通过面试，横线处填哪一个？
explanation: provided that 表示只要。so that 是目的，although 是让步，in case 是以防。

prompt: 哪一句的条件是“有两封推荐信”？

choices.text: We employed her provided that she has two references next year
Provided that she had two references, we employ her yesterday
We will employ her provided that she has two references
We employ her so that she has two references

explanation: provided that she has two references 是雇用的条件。
verify: "We will employ her provided that she has two references"

prompt: provided that 更接近哪一个意思？
explanation: provided that 表示只要，和 as long as 相近。

prompt: bread and butter 里，and 在正常语流中常常怎样？

choices.text: 不能和前后的词连起来

explanation: and 是功能词，句中常弱读。

prompt: 哪一类词更常弱读？

choices.text: 句中的名词实词一律弱读
冠词、介词、连词和助动词

explanation: 功能词常常弱读，实词通常保留重音。

prompt: I want to apply 里，to 在不强调时通常读成什么？

choices.text: 和 two 一样的长元音

explanation: to 不强调时元音常弱化成 /ə/。

prompt: 如果要强调就是这一份申请，可以重读哪一个词？

choices.text: this，而不是把 of 读重

explanation: 强调的信息落在实词 this 上，功能词 of 和 a 仍可弱读。

prompt: 想说周一以来已经参加了三次面试，哪一句合适？

choices.text: I had three interviews since Monday
I have three interviews since Monday as a past point
I have had three interviews since Monday
I will have three interviews since Monday

explanation: since Monday 到现在，用 have had。
verify: "I have had three interviews since Monday"

prompt: 想说只要在截止日期前交简历就会被看，哪一句合适？

choices.text: They read it yesterday provided that you will send it
Provided that send you, they will read
They will read it although you send it before the deadline
They will read it provided that you send it before the deadline

explanation: provided that you send 表示只要寄出。
verify: "They will read it provided that you send it before the deadline"

prompt: 想礼貌地问能否在周五前面试，哪一句合适？

choices.text: Could I come for an interview before Friday
Could I come for a interview before Friday
Could I come for an interviews before Friday
Could I came for an interview before Friday

explanation: Could I come 用来礼貌地询问安排。
verify: "Could I come for an interview before Friday"

prompt: 想说截止日期到来之前简历已经寄出，哪一句合适？

choices.text: I have sent the résumé before the deadline arrived
I had sent the résumé before the deadline arrived
I send the résumé before the deadline arrived
I will send the résumé before the deadline arrived

explanation: 寄出比 arrived 更早，用 had sent。
verify: "I had sent the résumé before the deadline arrived"

prompt: Lin has had two interviews since Monday. She had sent her résumé before the deadline arrived. The company will employ her provided that the references arrive this week. The next interview will take place on Friday. 自从周一起，Lin 参加了几次面试？
explanation: has had two interviews since Monday。

prompt: Lin has had two interviews since Monday. She had sent her résumé before the deadline arrived. The company will employ her provided that the references arrive this week. The next interview will take place on Friday. 截止日期到来时，简历是什么状态？
explanation: had sent her résumé before the deadline arrived。

prompt: Lin has had two interviews since Monday. She had sent her résumé before the deadline arrived. The company will employ her provided that the references arrive this week. The next interview will take place on Friday. 公司雇用她的条件是什么？
explanation: provided that the references arrive this week。

prompt: Lin has had two interviews since Monday. She had sent her résumé before the deadline arrived. The company will employ her provided that the references arrive this week. The next interview will take place on Friday. 下一次面试在什么时候？

choices.text: 截止日期当天已经结束

explanation: will take place on Friday。

prompt: 要点：周一起已有两次面试、截止日期前寄出了简历、只要推荐信本周到就会被雇用。哪一句三个要点都有？

choices.text: She has had two interviews since Monday, she had sent the résumé before the deadline, and they will employ her provided that the references arrive this week

explanation: 三个要点都要出现。
verify: "She has had two interviews since Monday, she had sent the résumé before the deadline, and they will employ her provided that the references arrive this week"

prompt: 邮件里表示下一次面试在周五，哪一句正确？

choices.text: The next interview took place on Friday
The next interview will take place on Friday
The next interview has taken place on Friday
The next interview takes place on Friday last year

explanation: 周五还未到，用 will take place。

prompt: 哪一句适合作为邮件的第一句？

choices.text: I am write to apply for the post
I am writing to applying for the post
I am writing to apply for the post

choices.text: You can start so that you pass the interview
You started yesterday provided that you pass

You can start provided that you pass the interview
